Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

Season your salmon filets with: salt, black pepper, paprika and olive oil. Cook using your preferred method… airfryer, stovetop or oven. I air fried mine at 400F for 12 minutes. 2. Bala baiana! These are Brazilian coconut bob bons! My friend @KITCHENTOOL thanks for the recipe! I searched so many recipes and his is the easiest to follow in my opinion! Check his page out! Ingredients: 1 tbsp salted butter 1 can (14oz)sweetened condensed milk  2/3 cup sweetened coconut flakes  Sugar coating: 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tbsp vinegar  How to: In a sauce pan add butter and turn it on medium heat until melted. Next add in sweetened condensed milk and coconut flakes. Stir on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until the mixture is thickened and can pull away from the pan. Add it into a separate bowl and place in the refrigerator until cooled.  Once cooled, take a tbsp of the mixture and roll it between greased hands to form a ball and place it onto a parchment lined pan until all of the mixture is formed into bite sized balls. Next in a sauce, pan, combine sugar, water, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, until it turns amber in color. Take off the heat. Next insert a toothpick into each ball and dip it into the amber sugar and place back onto a parchment lined pan.  Let cool and serve! #dessert #coconut #balabaiana #easyrecipe #recipeshare

Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. WARTOŚCI ODŻYWCZE NA 1 PORCJĘ: 825 kcal 62 g białka 39 g tłuszczu 57 g węglowodanów 4 g błonnika Chrupiący spód, miękkie ciasto i aromatyczny, soczysty farsz. Zdecydowanie jeden z tych przepisów, które warto zapisać! Zapisz i wyślij komuś, z kim zjadłbyś całą patelnię! #food #foodtok #cooking #recipe #dumplings

The high-protein, low-carb dinner I wish I knew about sooner… and best part, it only takes 15 minutes!! #RECIPE Enoki Beef Rolls 🍄 Ingredients (3-4 servings): 1 lb thinly sliced beef (I used “shabu shabu beef”) 7 oz enoki mushrooms 1 white onion, thinly sliced 1 tbsp oil (avocado oil preferred) 2 eggs, whisked Garnish: chopped green onions, sesame seeds Sauce: 1/3 cup water 1/4 cup soy sauce 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 garlic clove, minced Dash of pepper 🥩 Instructions: Prep the mushrooms – Trim the bottom 1-2 inches off the enoki mushrooms, rinse, and separate into small bundles. Roll it up – Lay out a slice of beef and roll each enoki bundle tightly inside. Repeat until all are wrapped. Make the sauce – Mix all sauce ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Sauté the onions – Heat oil in a large skillet over med-high heat, add onions, and cook for 3min until softened. Cook the rolls – Place the beef rolls over the onions in a single layer, pour in the sauce, cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low-med and simmer for 3min (until beef is cooked through). Add the eggs – Uncover, pour whisked eggs over the rolls, cover again, and cook for 1min.  Finish & serve – Salt to taste. Remove from heat, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy! #creatorsearchinsights

VIRAL CHUCK ROAST✨ my most popular recipe for good reason! I’ve received 100s of messages from you about how this recipe has become a staple in your family’s dinner routine 🥹 Some of you are making it WEEKLY and I’ve gotten so much feedback specifically that your kids are loving it - which makes me so happy! Let me know in the comments how YOU enjoy this easy recipe and share it with someone you think would love this crowd-pleasing chuck roast!  Ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast (about 4 pounds) 2 teaspoons kosher sea salt  1 teaspoon black pepper  Instructions: Preheat your oven to 325. Season the roast generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Add to a baking large casserole dish or Dutch oven, cover (with a lid or foil), and bake for 1 hr per pound of meat. Remove the roast from the oven and raise the oven temperate to 425.  Using two forks, shred the meat into large chunks. (If the roast is not pulling apart easily, put it back in the oven for 30 min). Toss the shredded pieces of roast around in the rendered fat and place it back in the oven, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes until you see some nice crispy ends.  Serve with mashed potatoes or roasted vegetables and enjoy! FAQs:  My roast is less than 4 lbs, how long should I cook it? Use the “hour per pound” method. How do I choose a good beef chuck roast? Look for nice fatty roast with lots of marbling. A roast that is too lean will not render enough juice. (Note: I have hit or miss luck with grass-fed roasts. Most are just too tough/lean and don't render enough fat for this preparation.)  How many people does this serve? A 4-pound roast serves 6-7 people. Do I need to sear it first?  Nope! The last part of the cook will give it some nice crispy bits without searing.  Did you add liquid? No, that is the juice rendered from the meat. My take on the viral beef kebab roll ups 😮‍💨🔥  What You’ll Need: For the Beef 	•	1 lb ground beef (80/20 works best) 	•	1 tbsp olive oil 	•	¼–½ cup finely diced onion 	•	¼–½ cup finely diced bell pepper 	•	Small handful fresh parsley, finely chopped 	•	2 garlic cloves, minced 	•	1 tsp curry powder 	•	1 tsp beef bouillon 	•	1 tsp garlic powder 	•	1 tsp onion powder 	•	1 tsp black pepper 	•	2 tsp paprika 	•	½ tsp cumin 	•	Salt to taste For Assembly 	•	Lavash bread or large flour tortillas 	•	Wooden skewers, soaked in water For the Chili Butter 	•	2 tbsp butter 	•	1 tbsp olive oil 	•	1 tsp tomato paste 	•	3 tsp paprika 	•	Salt to taste 	•	Optional: pinch of chili flakes for heat For Serving 	•	Plain yogurt or garlic yogurt 	•	Fresh parsley 	•	Lemon wedges How To Make Them Mix together the ground beef, onion, bell pepper, garlic, parsley, olive oil, and seasonings until smooth and slightly sticky. Cover and refrigerate for 20–30 minutes while soaking your skewers in water. Spread a thin layer of the beef mixture onto lavash bread or tortillas, roll tightly, then slice into pieces. Thread onto skewers, packing them closely together. Bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and cooked through. For the chili butter, melt together the butter and olive oil, then stir in the tomato paste, paprika, salt, and chili flakes if using. Let it cook for 30 seconds until glossy and fragrant. Brush the skewers generously with the chili butter, then broil for 1–2 minutes until lightly charred and crispy around the edges. Serve over garlic yogurt or alongside fries, then finish with fresh parsley and a squeeze of lemon. #cookwithme #kurveyskitchen #easymeals #viralfood #kebab

Honey Crispy Chicken Ingredients 	•	2 lbs chicken breasts, cubed 	•	2 eggs, beaten 	•	1 ½ cups cornstarch 	•	2 Tbsp soy sauce 	•	½ tsp black pepper 	•	¼ cup brown sugar 	•	¾ cup butter 	•	3–4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	¼ tsp red pepper flakes 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	½ cup honey 	•	1 Tbsp water 	•	1 Tbsp cornstarch (for slurry) 	•	Vegetable oil, for frying 	•	Steamed white rice, for serving ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3.	Make the Honey Sauce: 	•	In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. 	•	Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté until fragrant. 	•	Stir in brown sugar, ¼ cup soy sauce, and honey. Bring to a gentle boil. 	•	Mix 1 Tbsp water with 1 Tbsp cornstarch in a small bowl to make a slurry. Whisk into the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until thickened. 	4.	Combine & Serve: 	•	Add fried chicken to the sauce and toss until coated evenly. 	•	Serve hot over a bed of steamed white rice. #chicken #fyp #fypシ #viral #recipe

Would you make this?! I can’t wait to make it again! 🍁Fall Dinner Club, episode 3🍁featuring the VIRAL Chicken Au Poivre. Shoutout to @Corre Larkin for introducing me to this one! I’ve written out exactly how I made it below⬇️⬇️⬇️ and there’s a recipe card at the end for you.  Chicken Au Poivre Ingredients 1 whole chicken 1 tablespoon olive oil Salt and black pepper, to taste 2 teaspoons each garlic powder and onion powder For the sauce 1 shallot, finely diced 4 garlic cloves, minced 1–2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped About 1 teaspoon salt, or to taste About 1 Tbs. coarsely crushed black peppercorns 3 cups heavy cream, plus more to thin the sauce if needed 3 Tbs. cup sherry cooking wine Fresh chopped parsley, for garnish Directions Preheat your oven to 375°F. Using kitchen shears, cut through the breast side of the chicken and open it flat. Remove any giblets from the cavity, then pat the chicken dry. Drizzle with olive oil and season inside and out with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder. Place breast-side up in a roasting pan and roast for 15–20 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the shallot, garlic, rosemary, salt, crushed peppercorns, and heavy cream in a bowl. Remove the chicken from the oven and increase the temperature to 400°F. Pour the sherry cooking wine directly into the roasting pan around the chicken, then pour the cream mixture over the chicken. Return to the oven and roast for another 40–50 minutes, basting twice with the pan sauce. Cooking time will vary depending on the size of your chicken. Once the thickest part of the breast and the innermost thigh reach 165°F, remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest before carving. If needed, stir a few extra tablespoons of heavy cream into the pan sauce to thin it. Serve over mashed potatoes with plenty of extra sauce and a sprinkle of fresh parsley. Enjoy! #falldinner #chickenrecipe #dinnerrecipes #sundaydinner #chickenaupoivre
